title: Likhna nahi, bolna tha
caption:
Kabhi likhne se zyada bolna aasaan lagta hai? 👇
Waypoint, link in bio. 18+
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a young man who records a short voice post in Waypoint and hears it played back in a synthetic character voice. Voice posts are removed after 7 days. For adults 18 and over.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Kofi: Kofi is a thoughtful young man in his twenties with curly black hair, a mustard t-shirt and headphones around his neck.
cast.Friend: Friend is Kofi's roommate, a cheerful young man in a blue shirt.

scenes.vo: कोफ़ी को लिखना कभी पसंद नहीं था।
scenes.sub: Kofi ko likhna kabhi pasand nahi tha.
scenes.art: Kofi at a desk with a blank notes page and a pen, shaking his head, evening light.

scenes.vo: जो मन में था, वो शब्दों में अटकता था।
scenes.sub: Jo man mein tha, woh shabdon mein atakta tha.
scenes.art: Kofi crumpling a page of scribbles, a small pile of paper balls beside him.
Kofi pressing his headphones, taking a deep breath, mouth just opening to speak.

scenes.vo: वेपॉइंट में आवाज़ वाली पोस्ट होती है।
scenes.sub: Waypoint mein awaaz wali post hoti hai.
scenes.art: Kofi looking at his phone with an interested smile, sitting cross-legged on a sofa.

scenes.vo: भालू, लोमड़ी या गौरैया की आवाज़ चुनो।
scenes.sub: Bhaalu, lomdi ya gauraiya ki awaaz chuno.

scenes.vo: कोफ़ी ने तीस सेकंड बोला, और भालू चुना।
scenes.sub: Kofi ne tees second bola, aur bhaalu chuna.
scenes.art: Kofi speaking calmly toward his phone, a friendly cartoon bear icon floating gently near the phone.

scenes.vo: दीवार पर उसकी बात भालू की आवाज़ में बजी।
scenes.sub: Deewar par uski baat bhaalu ki awaaz mein baji.
scenes.art: Kofi listening on his phone with a surprised smile, soft sound waves drawn as warm lines around the phone.

scenes.vo: उसकी अपनी आवाज़ नहीं, बस उसके अपने शब्द।
scenes.sub: Uski apni awaaz nahi, bas uske apne shabd.
scenes.art: Kofi relaxed and smiling, a bear mascot silhouette in a speech bubble above his shoulder.

scenes.vo: सात दिन बाद वो पोस्ट हट जाती है।
scenes.sub: Saat din baad woh post hat jaati hai.
scenes.art: A wall calendar with seven days crossed off beside Kofi's window, gentle morning light.

scenes.vo: आप लिखना पसंद करेंगे या बोलना?
scenes.sub: Aap likhna pasand karenge ya bolna?
scenes.art: Close-up of Kofi smiling warmly at the viewer, headphones on his neck, sofa softly blurred behind.
